about: An act whose start scene is cut. A cut scene takes part in no span (§6.6.1), so Act II covers nothing and its scene stays in Act I (§5.5); the boundary is still there, so this is not `structure.boundary_dangling`, and without its own code the re-parenting would be silent.

findings.message: Act II starts at a cut scene, so it covers no scene and its scenes stay with the span before it (§5.5). Move its start to a scene in the film.
findings.title: Span starts at a cut scene
